context: Tests the full article authoring workflow: creating an article file with correct front matter, writing structured body content, and keeping the article as a draft. Graded by inspecting the article file and notes.md.

checklist.name: Article file created
checklist.description: A file exists under articles/ with a .md extension

checklist.name: Slug is valid length
checklist.description: The filename (slug) is between 12 and 50 characters

checklist.name: Slug format valid
checklist.description: The slug uses only lowercase alphanumeric characters, hyphens, and underscores

checklist.name: Type is tech
checklist.description: Front matter has type: tech (technical tutorial, not idea)

checklist.name: Topics count valid
checklist.description: Front matter topics array has between 1 and 5 items

checklist.name: Published is false
checklist.description: Front matter published field is false (draft, not yet published)

checklist.name: Title is set
checklist.description: Front matter title is a non-empty string

checklist.name: Emoji is set
checklist.description: Front matter emoji is a non-empty string containing an emoji character

checklist.name: Article has body content
checklist.description: The article body (below front matter) contains structured content with at least one heading

checklist.name: notes.md created
checklist.description: A notes.md file exists at the root of the workspace

checklist.name: Notes documents choices
checklist.description: notes.md explains the chosen slug, type, or topics with at least a brief rationale
